newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Pure trade halted after 24pct price rise.
newsitem.headline: Pure trade halted after 24pct price rise.

text.p: Trading in shares of Pure Beverages Co Ltd, the local Coca-Cola bottler, was halted by the stock exchange after its share price rose 24 percent to 30.50 from 24.50, an exchange official said.
"It is not a trading suspension, but only a halt until the company explains the reasons behind this sharp and unexplained rise," the official said.
Market analysts said the rise was unexpected, especially in the light of an on-going industrial dispute which has troubled Pure Beverages since November 1996.
A protest by more than 700 worker against a retrenchment plan has shut down two Pure Beverages bottling plants.
Pure Beverages is a subsidiary of F&NCC, a joint venture of Coca-Cola and Singapore's Fraser & Neave.
